verdict.rationale: Parsec documents full Wacom tablet support with pressure and tilt, so stylus input from a pen tablet does reach the host. It also lists an Android client. However, nothing in the evidence shows touchscreen gestures on a phone or tablet being mapped to host pointer events. Missing for 10: documented touch-to-pointer mapping on mobile/tablet clients, stylus support on touchscreen devices (beyond Wacom hardware), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt
Your controllers, Wacom tablet, software, and monitors can now go anywhere you want.
